subject: design/argus-artifacts
statement: `docs/problems/<slug>/delivery.md` holds: a closed header (slug only — status is derived, per DINV-6), a **derived state block** (**status: `open | parked | delivered`** — the one closed enum, derived from the journal — plus stage position against the pipeline map, open items, park state with ages; regenerated on every append, never cited, never authoritative), and the **`E-n` journal** — append-only typed entries from a **closed type vocabulary**: `stage-entered` · `ruling-recorded` · `assumption-recorded` · `item-materialized` · `brief-emitted` · `answer-received` · `proposal-disposed` · `reconciliation` · `bump-issued` · `delivered`. Every entry carries: type, date, **principal identity + authority-contract version** (FR-12), a gist body, and — wherever the act touched anything external — the **external-effect identity** (tracker item id, PR number, commit) that lets a resuming session verify the effect against its goal object before any redo. Type-specific fields bind the PRD's typed event properties: a `brief-emitted` entry carries `class: override | deadlock`; the `delivered` entry carries the touch count, breaking count, and spend fields (adapter-honest, `unavailable` legal); an `answer-received` entry cites its `A-n`. The journal closes with exactly one `delivered` entry, recorded only after mainline-content verification, and the file freezes; post-close overturns never touch it — the overturning artifact carries `overturns delivery:<slug>#E-n`, discoverable by reverse citation (design-brainstorm:argus-tech-design#D-8).
